recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up, high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man's face covered in heavy perspiration, utilizing dramatic side-lighting to emphasize skin texture and water droplets.
coreVisualRelationships: Light reflecting off water droplets against dark skin tones
Deep shadows in the eye sockets and under the nose creating a three-dimensional mask effect
Tight cropping that eliminates the background to focus on the intensity of the expression
Cool-toned desaturation enhancing the clinical, raw feel of the physical exertion
coreInvariants: Visible beads of sweat across the forehead and cheeks
Harsh directional lighting from one side
Extreme macro focus on skin pores and stubble

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, centered horizontally but slightly cropped at the top and sides for intimacy.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The highlight on the bridge of the nose and the moisture on the lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright highlights on the left cheek, moves across the bridge of the nose into the shadowed right eye, and down to the textured chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, limited to the soft-focus gray gradient in the far background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver for specular highlights on sweat droplets.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro portrait of a man with dark skin, heavily perspiring. Use harsh side lighting to create deep shadows on one half of the face. Focus on the texture of individual sweat droplets and skin pores. Use a cool-toned black and white color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, sans-serif typeface with wide tracking, placed in the negative space or overlapping the shadowed areas in a semi-transparent white.

verificationChecks: Are the sweat droplets sharp and reflective?
Is the lighting directional enough to create deep shadows?
Is the color palette strictly cool-toned and desaturated?
Is the crop tight enough to feel immersive?

adjustableVariables: Level of blue-tint in the monochrome

avoid: Soft focus on the main facial features

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic water refraction in droplets
Ensure the eyes have a subtle catchlight despite the shadows
Verify the stubble texture is distinct and sharp
Confirm the overall mood is intense and focused
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro + High Contrast + Perspiration + Side Lighting + Desaturated Cool Tones
